properties.description: BUILT 2026-10-25 under dec:the-two-renamed-stubs-are-removed-in-the-next-release. Both #[tool] stubs are gone (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/temporal_tools.rs) with service.rs's DEPRECATED_TOOLS list and find_tools' filter on it; deprecation::REGISTRY carries an entry for each (deprecated_in 0.91.0, the last release that served the refusing stub), so a call to either old name is refused with "What to do: call snapshot_before_change / manual_work_ledger, which takes the same arguments" (deprecation::removed_tool). The entries come out in the release after next. Served texts that named record_change now name snapshot_before_change. tests/fixtures/mcp_surface_at_last_release.json drops both from the last release's tools under `owner_approved_removals`, naming the decision, because that record predates the registry. The CHANGELOG fragment names each replacement. Served tools: 200 + 1 (record_the_build) - 2 = 199.
properties.name: The renamed stubs record_change and manual_work_report are no longer served; their old names are refused with their replacements for one release
